title: Other I got pound.
html_source:
Stephen reasons away his debt to A.E. by dissociating from his former self. Hamlet makes a similar argument disowning his offense to Laertes:

Was it Hamlet wronged Laertes? Never Hamlet.
If Hamlet from himself be ta'en away [by madness],
And when he’s not himself does wrong Laertes,
Then Hamlet does it not, Hamlet denies it.
